name: Burma Suite, Ocean Island Garden Suites
description: Make Ocean Island Suites your home away from home! Located in a historic character house in James Bay, Victoria BC (steps from the ocean, Beacon Hill Park, and the Inner Harbor), these suites are perfect for a family retreat, romantic getaway or weekend VICation!
neighborhood_overview: Our Suites are located in beautiful James Bay, Victoria BC. James Bay is the oldest neighbourhood in Victoria which is evidenced by the many beautiful character houses you'll find in the neighbourhood. Known for its tranquil and relaxed vibe, it's the perfect spot for a weekend getaway.
host_about:
“A seriously good deal for groups of up to four… in this renovated heritage home in a quiet residential enclave a short walk from Inner Harbour, each suite has an individual international theme – request the Burma suite and you’ll also get a claw-foot bathtub – along with hardwood floors, full kitchens and free wireless access. There’s a shared laundry… plus a large deck and quiet garden for summertime chilling.” – Lonely Planet Guidebook British Columbia, edition 3. 

Combine the privacy and freedom of a vacation rental with all the amenities of a hotel! 

Ocean Island Suites are located in the beautiful neighborhood of James Bay in Victoria, BC. Our suites are located in an historic 1907 character house which has been fully renovated, yet retains its unique character. The suites are steps from beautiful ocean beaches, as well as notable attractions such as the beautiful and renowned Beacon Hill Park, the Emily Carr house, the Royal BC Museum, the Legislative Buildings, and the Inner Harbour. Perfect for a family retreat or a romantic getaway, each of these quiet, colourful suites has a queen-sized bed, full kitchen, bathroom with bathtub and shower, work and living area, cable TV and more!

Each suite is uniquely decorated; you have the choice of our sleek Tokyo suite, decorated in red and black with a modern take on Asian-influenced style; our bright Provence suite, decorated in a light, cheery colour scheme invoking the South of France; or our warm Burma suite, beautifully decorated in rich reds and browns and showcasing authentic South-East Asian artwork.

•24-hour front desk at our main location, available by phone
•Please note that any emails sent past 10:30pm will not be received until the next morning. 
•Maintenance available to deal with any issue right away

•Full kitchen with fridge/freezer, microwave, stove, oven, cutlery, dishes, cookware – it’s set up just like home!
•Bathroom with bathtub and shower
•Wired Internet and free wireless Internet in the suite and all around the property, including the back garden
•20 inch TV with and cable
•Fold-out couch turns into a large single bed
•Original 1907 fir wood floors
•Access to shared large backyard with garden and deck
•Access to on-site laundry facilities ($2 per wash and dry)
•Free Parking (off street and street)
•Storage available
•High chair & crib available upon request

 
You'll have access to all the travel information and insider's tips you'll need! Each guest is given a welcome package with FAQs and a general map of the neighborhood when checking into the suites. You can also call our 24 hour front desk for information.

The Ocean Island suites are a part of the family-owned business Ocean Island Inn | Backpackers | Suites, with our main location in central downtown Victoria. host_about:
I'm a local Victorian, spent my 20s in Montreal and NYC, then came home to Victoria and designed and built this house.  Initially obsessed with modern architecture, this passion met with a desire to live more lightly; this house project is my experiment with integrating greenbuilding technologies and practices and overcoming the technical, regulatory, and financial barriers preventing their mainstreaming.  From this project, i have done some green building consulting for homeowners, developers and the BC provincial government.  I'm currently working for local government as the environmental issues planner for Victoria and am responsible for developing the city's climate action program, both for its own operations and in partnership with the community to reduce energy and greenhouse gases in VIctoria.  I love my job.
I also love this city, and giving visitors tips so they can enjoy a most local experience.  Victoria is rich with natural and manmade bounty, there are outstanding small/local eats and cafes to be found in nearby neighbourhoods. i picked the location of this house to build because it's on a quiet deadend street, while being situated a 5min walk to core of downtown or to the heart of fernwood village. come visit...

neighborhood_overview:
The best thing about the Gorge Tillicum neighbourhood is the Gorge, a tidal waterway right across the road, which you can sit and look at from the dining table.

The Gorge Walkway has been beautifully developed and is well maintained and popular with walkers, runners, rowers, canoe/ kayak / dragon boat paddlers, birds, seals and even - in the heat of summer - with swimmers.

It's a bike-friendly neighbourhood with quiet side streets and bike lanes on the main thoroughfare, connecting you with the Galloping Goose bike trail, which spans a total of 60km of gorgeous West Coast scenery.

It's a quiet residential area with good transportation links (road and bus) - downtown/university bus stops 5-10 minutes walk away - and a great position for getting out of town, whether to head up-island, out to the Western Communities or the West coast of the island, or go to/from airport and ferries.

name: Foxglove Farm Classic Cottage B&B
description: Foxglove Farm is a 120-acre organic farm on Salt Spring Island in British Columbia, Canada. The farm is located on one of the original homesteads on the island nestled in a mountain, forest and lake ecosystem rich in flora, fauna and natural history.
neighborhood_overview:
Foxglove Farm is nestled in the heart of Salt Spring Island next to Mt. Maxwell Provincial Park. Abundant hiking and biking as well as quiet walks on the farm. It is located just 10 minutes outside of Ganges.

Foxglove Farm is nestled in a mountain, forest and lake ecosystem rich in flora, fauna and natural history. Surrounded by hundreds of acres of protected forest and agricultural fields, bordering Maxwell Lake, we are just minutes from hiking trails entering Mount Maxwell Provincial Park.
host_about:
Your hosts are Michael Ableman and Jeanne Marie Herman. 

Michael Ableman, farmer, author, photographer and food advocate, has been farming organically from since the 1970′s and is considered among the pioneers of the international movement. Renowned for his commercial scale organic farming techniques, Ableman has lectured audiences all over the world about the urban food revolution and agricultural conservation easement.

Jeanne Marie Herman has a B.A. in Environmental Studies, with minors in Botany and Urban Planning from the University of California at Santa Barbara, 1986. She has worked as a field biologist, an outdoor educator, environmental consultant, research project manager, education coordinator and farm manager. Jeanne Marie Herman was a founding board member of The Center for Urban Agriculture at Fairview Gardens in Goleta, Ca., At UCSB Geography Department she worked as a research technician for 5 years.

Jeanne-Marie is currently co-owner and founder of The Centre For Arts, Ecology, and Agriculture and partners with her husband, Michael Ableman, in managing Foxglove Farm.

neighborhood_overview:
If you want to be near the commercial district of Pender, this is not for you. We are as far away from all that as you can get. We are within walking distance to multiple beaches, trails and parks. A quick 5 minute walk takes you to excellent beach combing and tidal pools at Craddock Beach, the location of Tilly Point Caves, a popular shore dive. Orca sightings and sunsets at Brooks Point Park (15 minute walk) and walk the shoreline further south to explore the pebbly beach at Gowlland Point Park (20 minute walk), said to be one of the prettiest beaches of the two Penders. A short drive takes you to the base of a hike into the picturesque wetlands at Greenburn Lake Park. Wildlife abounds, eagles, raven, seabirds, mink, otters and seals. Bring your binoculars, lace up your hiking boots, bike or launch a kayak.
The south island is rural and quiet.
We are 20-30 minutes walking distance from Poet's Cove Resort and Spa, bistro and bar.

Now retired, we reside permanently at our seaside dream home a short drive from the Tall House. We spend each day exploring the shores, walking the forests, taking the boat out to fish or crab, or relaxing in the garden.

description:
This quiet, friendly, family-oriented home is in a great location. It's a quick trip to downtown Victoria by car, bike & bus. Easy access to Vic General Hospital, Thetis Lake, Royal Roads University, Western Communities, West Coast beaches, Saanich Peninsula and Up-Island. Bike and hiking trails are minutes away. Notes: The fireplace is not available.
neighborhood_overview:
This is a beautiful residential, suburban neighbourhood, unknown by most Victorians. I'm close to the water, just across the street from a small beach on Esquimalt Harbour. Thetis Lake is five minutes away by car, great for swimming and hiking. Esquimalt Lagoon, Fort Rodd Hill and Royal Roads (Hatley Castle gardens and trails) are also nearby, a joy to explore. I'm very close to the Galloping Goose and E&N bike trails.

PLEASE take a minute to check the map and confirm this is where you want to be. View Royal is about 7 km from downtown Victoria, easy to get to by car, bike or bus. But if you're looking for a more urban location, with lots of stores, restaurants and coffee shops, check out places right downtown or in Esquimalt, Vic West, Fairfield, Fernwood or James Bay.

View Royal is right at the junction of Vancouver Island and the Saanich Peninsula, so it's great base for exploring the whole South Island. You can head:
- East to visit Victoria
- We
host_about:
I live in Victoria, B.C. and love to travel. Paris is my home-away-from-home, and I've been to France many times. In the past few years, I have also fallen in love with Istanbul, Berlin, Lisbon, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Budapest, New York City, London, Tokyo, Kyoto, Hangzhou and Shanghai. 

I know what it's like to be both a guest and a host. I rent my whole house when I'm on the road, and share it with guests when I'm here. I like meeting and getting to know other travellers, collecting inspiration for future trips! I'm a casual and independent guest/host, comfortable to sit and chat, or do my own thing and let you do yours. 

The more I explore the world, the more I realize how lucky I am to live in Victoria. I see it with fresh eyes every time I come home, and am blown away yet again by how clean, fresh, beautiful and accessible it is.

Victoria is only 45 minutes away. The BC Royal Museum is great; the bug museum fun for the kids; and walking around the harbour watching the boats and street performers is a fun way to spend the day.
Poirier Cove is well located on Vancouver Island to explore as much as you like - or stay home and hang out on the beach.

Bennett Bay Beach, Campbell Bay, Dinner Bay, and Piggott Bay Beach are popular spots and tend to have the warmest water. Most beaches are dog-friendly but please remember to pick up after your pets.

Pender Island is one of the Southern Gulf Islands on the Pacific Coast of British Columbia, Canada. Pender Island lies between Vancouver and Victoria, BC.

Pender offers the most public beach access points of any of the Gulf Islands and actually consists of two islands, North Pender and South Pender, which are separated by a narrow canal connected by a one-lane bridge. We are on South Pender.

We enjoy a sub-Mediterranean climate, verdant farmland, rolling hills, areas of mossy rain forest, several lakes, some small mountains, and many quiet coves and beaches.

host_about:
Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.

description: Foxglove Farm is a 120-acre organic farm on Salt Spring Island in British Columbia, Canada. The farm is located on one of the original homesteads on the island nestled in a mountain, forest and lake ecosystem rich in flora, fauna and natural history.
neighborhood_overview:
Foxglove Farm is nestled in the heart of Salt Spring Island next to Mt. Maxwell Provincial Park. Abundant hiking and biking as well as quiet walks on the farm. It is located just 10 minutes outside of Ganges.

Foxglove Farm is nestled in a mountain, forest and lake ecosystem rich in flora, fauna and natural history. Surrounded by hundreds of acres of protected forest and agricultural fields, bordering Maxwell Lake, we are just minutes from hiking trails entering Mount Maxwell Provincial Park.
host_about:
Your hosts are Michael Ableman and Jeanne Marie Herman. 

Michael Ableman, farmer, author, photographer and food advocate, has been farming organically from since the 1970′s and is considered among the pioneers of the international movement. Renowned for his commercial scale organic farming techniques, Ableman has lectured audiences all over the world about the urban food revolution and agricultural conservation easement.

Jeanne Marie Herman has a B.A. in Environmental Studies, with minors in Botany and Urban Planning from the University of California at Santa Barbara, 1986. She has worked as a field biologist, an outdoor educator, environmental consultant, research project manager, education coordinator and farm manager. Jeanne Marie Herman was a founding board member of The Center for Urban Agriculture at Fairview Gardens in Goleta, Ca., At UCSB Geography Department she worked as a research technician for 5 years.

Jeanne-Marie is currently co-owner and founder of The Centre For Arts, Ecology, and Agriculture and partners with her husband, Michael Ableman, in managing Foxglove Farm.

name: private seaside room on quiet horse and sheep farm
description: an adult only retreat~4 minutes west of Ganges, enjoy the peaceful tidal inlet steps from your bedside, with eagles calling, heron and kingfisher nearby, horses and sheep grazing in the meadows.  A comfy retreat with a large shaded seaside deck to enjoy amazing sunsets. The room is in a private wing of the farmhouse with a comfy king bed,  a spacious bathroom with a huge shower and soaker tub, so relaxing. A light breakfast of granola and fruit is in your fridge~ You may be greeted by a whippet~
neighborhood_overview: located in "West Ganges", the farm is tucked away in a tidal inlet where the evenings offer a quiet night's sleep. Guests can aim for all the popular spots from this central location. A moonlit canoe ride has become a favored activity with the magic of effervescence in the paddle strokes through the still waters of the inlet. Cyclists enjoy the convenient location, yet those on foot are best to consider the bus system to get around, or rent a car, moped, or bike.
host_about:
Hello and welcome to the farm. It has grown since 1989, with a goal to be fully self-sustaining.  There is an awareness of the abundance of treasures mother nature offers in plant and wildlife, and the alternative lifestyle to consuming and throwing out plastics and waste every day.  The bird life is spectacular, with resident woodpecker, owl, raven, heron, kingfisher, swallow, robin, and of course, the magnificent eagles. They built a nest right above the dining room glass solarium, and have had many babies in it!! The barn is home to 4 horses. Their duty is to keep the lawns mowed, and provide added beauty to the grounds. A whippet lives here. Four babydoll sheep arrived in April 2020, lavender maran hens came as well. In 2021 3 baby lambs arrived, and 3 babydoll ewes were purchased, totalling 9 sheep. There are now hens brooding, chicks chirping, and lambs baaing. 
 It's wonderful to have a quiet retreat that is so close to the fun happenings in the little town of Ganges and adventures sprinkled throughout the island. 
The farm has changed it's offerings once the shut down occurred March 2020, and no longer offers breakfasts at the big farmhouse table, now the farmhouse has a quiet offering in one wing with the Seaside Room and it's private bathroom.

name: Oceanfront 1@Morningstone w. kayaks, Mayne Is., BC
description: Morningstone on Mayne is a masterwork mosaic of places we have visited and loved: English gardens, Cotswold stone, European castles,  Mediterranean stairways & arches, Guatemalan courtyards. Greg asked himself, “What could one man build with his own two hands?” So he cut & set each stone. Cut & shaped each tree. Forged & hammered iron. Three self-contained suites with private entrances are safe and restorative spaces, each with oceanfront balcony, just steps down to a sandy beach with kayaks.
neighborhood_overview: The beach, just steps away, is perfect for launching a kayak and paddling in some of the most beautiful sealife-filled waters in the world. Mayne Island in the Southern Gulf Islands is a choice destination for sailing, kayaking, biking, and for walking the beautiful seaside and forest trails. Our island is a restful but vibrant home to artists and writers, to small farmers and to ordinary, hard working folk like ourselves. The peaceful outdoor and indoor beauty of Morningstone makes this an ideal retreat for rest, writing and creative expression. From your room, enjoy the summer sunset views over Galiano and Saltspring Islands, kingfishers and osprey diving for fish, otters and seals in the bay, orcas swimming into Active Pass and the deer wandering by. Restaurants, bakery, and grocery store (with deli and fresh produce) are in Miners' Bay, 3 km. away. The Japanese Gardens in Dinner Bay are within walking distance.
host_about: We are Dorothy and Greg, 46 years married. When our 4 children were young, we traveled through Central America, Europe, North Africa and Turkey in a tiny-home-on-wheels. Morningstone reflects the many places we have loved and called home. Greg is usually building something of stone. After years of university teaching, Dorothy is happily writing a storytelling micro-history of Village Bay, gardening and grand-parenting (with Greg) our 7 grands.

name: Oceanfront 2@Morningstone w. kayaks, Mayne Is., BC
description: Morningstone on Mayne is a masterwork mosaic of places we have visited and loved: English gardens, Cotswold stone, European castles,  Mediterranean stairways & arches, Guatemalan courtyards. Greg asked himself, “What could one man build with his own two hands?” So he cut & set each stone. Cut & shaped each tree. Forged & hammered iron. Three self-contained suites with private entrances are safe and restorative spaces, each with oceanfront balcony, just steps down to a sandy beach with kayaks.
neighborhood_overview: The beach, just steps away, is perfect for launching a kayak and paddling in some of the most beautiful sealife-filled waters in the world. Mayne Island in the Southern Gulf Islands is a choice destination for sailing, kayaking, biking, and for walking the beautiful seaside and forest trails. Our island is a restful but vibrant home to artists and writers, to small farmers and to ordinary, hard working folk like ourselves. The peaceful outdoor and indoor beauty of Morningstone makes this an ideal retreat for rest, writing and creative expression. From your room, enjoy the summer sunset views over Galiano and Saltspring Islands, kingfishers and osprey diving for fish, otters and seals in the bay, orcas swimming into Active Pass and the deer wandering by. Restaurants, bakery, and grocery store (with deli and fresh produce) are in Miners' Bay, 3 km. away. The Japanese Gardens in Dinner Bay are within walking distance.
host_about: We are Dorothy and Greg, 46 years married. When our 4 children were young, we traveled through Central America, Europe, North Africa and Turkey in a tiny-home-on-wheels. Morningstone reflects the many places we have loved and called home. Greg is usually building something of stone. After years of university teaching, Dorothy is happily writing a storytelling micro-history of Village Bay, gardening and grand-parenting (with Greg) our 7 grands.

description: Adults only,  comfy spacious cottage on a private setting! Close driving distance to parks, hiking, art and culture, great views, restaurants & the beaches. host_about:
Hello and welcome to the farm. It has grown since 1989, with a goal to be fully self-sustaining.  There is an awareness of the abundance of treasures mother nature offers in plant and wildlife, and the alternative lifestyle to consuming and throwing out plastics and waste every day.  The bird life is spectacular, with resident woodpecker, owl, raven, heron, kingfisher, swallow, robin, and of course, the magnificent eagles. They built a nest right above the dining room glass solarium, and have had many babies in it!! The barn is home to 4 horses. Their duty is to keep the lawns mowed, and provide added beauty to the grounds. A whippet lives here. Four babydoll sheep arrived in April 2020, lavender maran hens came as well. In 2021 3 baby lambs arrived, and 3 babydoll ewes were purchased, totalling 9 sheep. There are now hens brooding, chicks chirping, and lambs baaing. 
 It's wonderful to have a quiet retreat that is so close to the fun happenings in the little town of Ganges and adventures sprinkled throughout the island. 
The farm has changed it's offerings once the shut down occurred March 2020, and no longer offers breakfasts at the big farmhouse table, now the farmhouse has a quiet offering in one wing with the Seaside Room and it's private bathroom.

description:
We are located on serene Long Harbour on beautiful Salt Spring Island. Our property is on the water and has access to the beach through our forest trail. Farm animals including a horse, sheep, and chickens are here to welcome you - adding some country flair to your stay with us. The cottage provides a private, peaceful, island retreat where you can choose your desired stay - adventurous or relaxing or a bit of both!

BBQ!!
Located on a major bus route, free on premises parking.
Bright, cozy and clean!
neighborhood_overview:
Located just a short walk to UVIc, Camoson college and Shelborne plaza.
In the plaza you will find restaurants, grocers, banks, hair salons, dry cleaners and more. If you are feeling like a hike, Mount Tolmie is your backyard, many trails, picnic areas and 360 degree views of the city, ocean and mountains. host_about:
Hi my name is Barbara I am from Venezuela, my husband Barry is from Canada and we have two fantastic children. Having recently moved to Victoria after living abroad for many years, our love of travel has taken us on journey's in many countries and has given us a better understanding of the diverse cultures in our world. 
My favorite destinations so far have been New York, Patagonia, Margarita Island, Rome and I have to admit that I am in love with Victoria BC. This city has so much to offer! I am fascinated with the architecture of the houses, it is a pleasure just to drive around and see the different styles of houses in the many different neighbourhoods. 
As you know we are surrounded by the ocean and we are ocean goers! We love to spend time aboard our boat exploring the Gulf Islands, crab, salmon fishing, or just relaxing on some remote beach as the kids paddle their kayak. Summers here on the island are magical! 
One of my passions is interior design, this combined with Barry's creativity and skills we have managed to create this little oasis in the middle of the city. 
As hosts we are pleased to offer our Airbnb "Luxury Studio Apartment" and hope that we reflect within the suite, those little things (lessons learned in our travels), that will make your stay a comfortable and memorable experience!

name: Castaway in James Bay, BC!
description:
Castaway in James Bay is a handsome townhouse, just 3 minutes walk to Fisherman's Wharf, the seafront walkway along the Inner Harbour to downtown & the US Ferries. Restaurants & cafes are at its doorstep. You’ll love its light & tranquility, plus sunny outdoor seating, not to mention two ensuite bathrooms! It is good for adventurers & families.
City of Victoria business licence #00034990.

Upscale hotels on the waterfront are in the same 'hood.  And there's an Italian restaurant right across the street.  And yet, the neighborhood is surprisingly quiet, with the exception of the gulls, and in the summer tour buses taking vacationers back to the cruise ships a 15-minute walk away.  There's even a small church right next door.

host_about:
Hello, I'm a single mom of 2 lovely, grown daughters and 1 grown dog (Mexi... she has an intimidating bark, but not a bite). :-)  I am blessed to live in one of the most beautiful cities in Canada.  I get to walk every day surrounded by the beauty of Victoria, BC.  I have travelled all over the world myself and I love all kinds of different foods.  I regularly attend concerts and festivals and any type of event involving the Arts.  French red wine is my favorite beverage, but a nice Mojito is my 2nd choice. 
I would love to show you where all the great spots are to eat, drink and see wonderful sights in my city!  I try to be present in every moment and positive about life.  Hope to meet you soon. :-)

After a few years of hosting on Airbnb, I have enjoyed meeting so many new people and I hope I have helped them enjoy visiting Victoria, BC.  I feel it's important for my guests to have clear expectations (especially the new members who don't have much Airbnb experience).   My home is cozy and I do my best to keep it very clean.  I don't offer any fully private apartments or vacation homes, this is my own home that I am offering to share with the Airbnb community.  Please make yourself at home when you stay with me, but keep in mind that this isn't a hotel or even a fancy bed & breakfast establishment.  I may not have every convenience, but whatever conveniences I own, I am willing to share with my fellow Airbnb members.  :-)

host_about:

They have always wanted to create a bed and breakfast but never got around to it. My mother, unfortunately passed away in 2014. We are now full-filling her wish to open her home to guests from around the world to share and enjoy the beauty of Vancouver Island that we have had the privilege to call home for over 50 years.  

We are in a two phase process. We are opening the first suite in our house at the moment and will have an 1100 sq ft. guest home on the property available by spring. We are continuing my mother's love of flower gardens to create an inviting yard to sit and relax on a warm summer evening or pull a ripe apple or plum from my mother's fruit trees. 

I owned and rented a guest cottage in California back in the '80's and had so much fun and many wonderful memories with our clients. We look forward to meeting you and creating new ones!

Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.

name: Oceanfront 3@Morningstone w. kayaks, Mayne Is., BC
description: Morningstone on Mayne is a masterwork mosaic of places we have visited and loved: English gardens, Cotswold stone, European castles,  Mediterranean stairways & arches, Guatemalan courtyards. Greg asked himself, “What could one man build with his own two hands?” So he cut & set each stone. Cut & shaped each tree. Forged & hammered iron. Three self-contained suites with private entrances are safe and restorative spaces, each with oceanfront balcony, just steps down to a sandy beach with kayaks.
neighborhood_overview: The beach, just steps away, is perfect for year-round "wild swimming", launching a kayak and paddling in some of the most beautiful sealife-filled waters in the world. Mayne Island in the Southern Gulf Islands is a choice destination for sailing, kayaking, biking, and for walking the beautiful seaside and forest trails. Our island is a restful but vibrant home to artists and writers, to small farmers and to ordinary, hard working folk like ourselves. The peaceful outdoor and indoor beauty of Morningstone makes this an ideal retreat for rest, writing and creative expression. From your room, enjoy the summer sunset views over Galiano and Saltspring Islands, kingfishers and osprey diving for fish, otters and seals in the bay, orcas swimming into Active Pass and the deer wandering by. Restaurants, bakery, and grocery store (with deli and fresh produce) are in Miners' Bay, 3 km. away. The Japanese Gardens in Dinner Bay are within walking distance.
host_about: We are Dorothy and Greg, 46 years married. When our 4 children were young, we traveled through Central America, Europe, North Africa and Turkey in a tiny-home-on-wheels. Morningstone reflects the many places we have loved and called home. Greg is usually building something of stone. After years of university teaching, Dorothy is happily writing a storytelling micro-history of Village Bay, gardening and grand-parenting (with Greg) our 7 grands.

The University of Victoria is located partly within Gordon Head along the southeast boundary. Finnerty Road separates Gordon Head from the adjacent neighbourhood of Cadboro Bay. The local area is dominated physically by Mt. Douglas, a coastline along Haro Strait, and the central plateau.

Gordon Head has 27 parks ranging in size from the minuscule Balmacarra Park (671 m2 (0.166 acres)) to the magnificent Mount Douglas Park (181 ha (450 acres)), the largest park in Saanich.

Several parks offer beach access. The half-rocky, half-sandy beach located between Arbutus Cove Park and Hollydene Park is Gordon Head's most frequented beach.

name: Wickham's Wake - Wild Luxury 3BR Oceanfront Rental
description: Enjoy wild luxury in this beautiful oceanfront rental with all the amenities of home, and access to some of best fishing and hiking on the west coast of Vancouver Island.  After a day of exploring Port Renfrew on land or sea, prepare your meals in a fully equipped kitchen or on the propane BBQ overlooking the water.  Enjoy meals family-style at the large wood dining table that seats six. There are three outdoor living areas for you to enjoy, including a fire pit under the stars.
neighborhood_overview:
Located in a the Wild Coast Cottage community. There are neighbours close by. Privacy may be limited in outdoor areas.

Please note that each cottage in the neighbourhood is privately owned. If you visit at another cottage and bring dishes, chairs etc. please be sure to return them to their original cottage. Some cottages are rented like ours, but most are used only by their owners and families. Please be respectful of their privacy and property.
host_about:
Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.

host_about:
We love sharing our incredible home with visitors, friends and family. We live here and it still feels like we are renting a piece of paradise! We love enjoying the view, the tranquility and the peace with nature. 

In our neighborhood, we enjoy taking our two little girls and our dog Blue to Whiffen Spit, Ella Beach and all the places in between and farther afield. We enjoy meeting people and soaking up the relaxed Sooke community atmosphere.

We are lucky to spent a lot of time in beautiful Sooke because Eoghan works from home and Maitreyi travels as a flight attendant. 

We love traveling, hiking and living. Our favourite way to travel is to setup a base where we can meet the locals and explore the area. We love AirBNB for this! We have stayed at some incredible places, met some amazing people and formed great memories! 

A Bit About Us
Eoghan got his start as a photographer and filmmaker carrying too much camera equipment on wilderness trips to some of the remote places in the world. Over the past decade, many adventures have followed in some of the amazing places on this earth including a solar powered filming trek across the Zanskar region of India, a double helicopter evacuation in 96 hours from Baffin Island and documenting multiple marathon cycling journeys across Canada and the United States.

Eoghan believes that photographs and imagery of large places and scenes should be reproduced as large as possible. His panoramic fine art prints have exhibited at galleries in the Vancouver area as well as at juried events in Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver. His art prints adorn personal and commercial spaces as far away as Japan and Ireland and can be found throughout Sooke Mountain House.

Maitreyi is a born traveler. Since as long as she can remember she has always kept one bag packed and one eye open for the next memory. She works for one of Canada's airlines and has been fortunate enough to explore many parts of the world.

The weather, the mountains, the Inner Harbour, the ocean, fresh air, great dining, pubs, music  and the wonderful people of this city made it impossible to ever leave!  I raised our kids here, and now get to enjoy it with my 10 grandchildren (who are the best part of my life!)  

I moved onto Solid Rock Acres 30 years ago, and built this dream home with family in 2008.  When the kids moved off the property back in 2016, I decided to share this beautiful space with travellers, and it has been an amazing experience!  Meeting wonderful people from all over the world has been a highlight of hosting with Airbnb, and I look forward to meeting you!

I personally love the outdoor beauty of this area, so close to downtown, the lakes, hiking, ocean, fishing, golfing and yet on the outskirts of the city!  The heritage buildings of downtown Victoria, the many beaches and of course, Butchart Gardens are among our favourite places to enjoy with family and friends!  There are excellent wineries and breweries as well as world class dining experiences to be enjoyed!  I've shared a few of my favourites in my host manual, so check them out!

I hope you fall in love with Victoria as much as I have!  Enjoy!

An absolutely beautiful, quiet newly built 2 bedroom, full bath, spacious guest suite with covered walk out patio deck and 1/4 acre backyard with dock access to private Prospect Lake. Well lit living/dining room offers a panoramic view. Comes packed with new kitchen amenities, TV and Wifi.

Minutes away from popular attractions, hiking, fresh and salt water fishing and amenities:

- Butchart Gardens - 10 min.
- Airport - 22 min.
- Victoria Inner Harbour- 30 min.
- BC Ferries - 25 min.

With a loving family, I am a career driven down to earth family man. We love to enjoy all Vancouver island has to offer whether it be hiking, kayaking, boating or dining out at one of the many local delicious restaurants.  We are proud to call Vancouver island home. 

As an early riser, you will find me with several projects on the go which I always finish once I start. My wife and I have made a commitment to keep a clean, organized and respectful home and you’ll notice the same with the property. 

As our guest, you will have many opportunities to be active during your stay whether it be kayaks, paddle boards or fishing. It’s also important to kick back and relax in the hot tub, or with your feet hanging off the dock and with your toes in the water. The suite is equipped with all the amenities that I like to have when a full day of work is complete.  

We welcome any of your suggestions and grateful for your feedback.

description:

RECENT BYLAW ALLOWS ONLY 30 NIGHT BOOKINGS. INQUIRE TO MAKE YOUR PLANS WORK.

neighborhood_overview:
Sidney with its mild climate, amazing natural setting, variety of restaurants and unique boutiques is hard to beat. Don't forget to start up conversations with the locals to find out more about our community. We’re a friendly little town.

If you want to get out and enjoy nature you might enjoy the waterfront walk that starts right outside your SeaSuite and continues past the Victoria Distillery, to the end of the pier and beyond. There are loads of hiking and biking trails near by. If you want to explore the coastline, rent kayaks from Port Sidney Marina. Whale watching is especially popular and can also be coordinated right at Port Sidney Marina. If you are looking for an easy and beautiful daytrip hop on the Sidney Island ferry and visit the best sandy beach in all of the Salish Sea.

Want to learn more about the Salish Sea? Visit the educational and informative Shaw Discovery Center. They take you “beneath” the surface to visit the local marine life.
host_about: We are a family for four that loves to travel. Thankfully our kids enjoy it as much as we do. Living in Victoria on Vancouver Island, Canada we have access to some wonderful sailing and spend as much time as possible on our sailboat. We enjoy local markets and exploring the countryside. Look forward to meeting you!

We are pretty social and outgoing but we won't get in your face if you need peace.  Otherwise, let's light up the pizza oven or bbq (if there's no fire restrictions that is)! We also have a lovely therapeutic hot tub for some serious R&R.

There are more hikes and beaches than you could ever check out in a short time.
Deer are everywhere (usually in our back yard), and there is a beach within a 20 minute walk (or a five minute drive) that is on the "whale trail' (the orcas and humpbacks regular route).

The famous Pender disc park is our backyard, so bring some discs if you want to play! It's free!
There is also a nine hole golf course on Pender if REAL golf is what you prefer! :)
If you love nature and art, you will never be bored on Pender!

neighborhood_overview:
Gordon Head is a seaside neighbourhood in the Greater Victoria municipality of Saanich. Gordon Head lies north of McKenzie Avenue and east of the Blenkinsop Valley. The University of Victoria is located partly within Gordon Head along the southeast boundary. Finnerty Road separates Gordon Head from the adjacent neighbourhood of Cadboro Bay. The local area is dominated physically by Mt. Douglas, a coastline along Haro Strait, and the central plateau.

Gordon Head has 27 parks ranging in size from the minuscule Balmacarra Park (671 m2 (0.166 acres)) to the magnificent Mount Douglas Park (181 ha (450 acres)), the largest park in Saanich.

Several parks offer beach access. The half-rocky, half-sandy beach located between Arbutus Cove Park and Hollydene Park is Gordon Head's most frequented beach.

description:

Our place is close to the town of Sooke yet surrounded by farms, close to beaches, located on a peaceful, forested 2 acres. neighborhood_overview: Our neighbourhood is all about beaches! The first beach down Westcoast road is Gordons Beach, located a 5-minute drive from our home. The next beach is Muir Creek Beach a few minutes drive down Westcoast road with a 15 meter high siltstone cliff containing well-defined marine fossils in a variety of strata. We have China Beach, Sandcut Beach, Mystic Beach, Jordon River, Sombrio Beach, Botanical Beach and Port Renfrew, all within an hour drive from our place. host_about:
Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year.

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it.

host_about: Hello, welcome to my Air B and B listing, I am new to all this and just want to invite you to come and spend time in a beautiful sunny location. I have lived on this property for 24 years and have spent those years exploring the south coast of the Island. It is truly a beautifully exceptional area. I am a carpenter by trade and have spent many years building and now supervising projects on the island and in other parts of the world. A few years ago, after a large windstorm swept through the island, I lost a bunch of trees on my land, after the big cleanup I needed something to do with all the big beautiful trees that would honour them for many years to come. I imagine every carpenter likely has a dream to build themselves a  home as did I, so I got busy had the trees milled up to fine lumber and now have a beautiful second home on my property that I now live in. The original house is in great shape as I spent many years doing renovations and keeping it beautiful too. I am now wanting to share the beauty of my land and home with others, so I welcome you to come check it out.

name: Tiny House in Salt Spring's Beautiful South End
description: Nestled amongst tall cedars, Tiny Haven is situated in the magical south end of Salt Spring Island on a quiet and peaceful no-through residential road.  The south end boasts lush rainforest, idyllic and secluded beaches, and rolling farmland, and all of these are within walking distance from Tiny Haven.   Whether you've come to retreat into quietude or adventure in nature, you'll feel at home in this private, self-contained and uniquely appointed little space.
neighborhood_overview:
We simply cannot say enough good things about the deep south of Salt Spring. We can direct you to several excellent nearby hiking trails, and where to eat afterwards, from the nearby Salt Spring Island Cheese Company to Fulford's Rock Salt restaurant. The Mercantile at Fulford Harbour, a 12 minute drive from Tiny Haven, is a surprisingly well stocked and licensed grocer. Fulford Harbour also boasts a waterfront restaurant, post office, pottery studio, and an eclectic gift shop.
Ganges is a pleasant and scenic 20 minute drive north. Make sure to have cash on hand and drive slowly, as you'll want to stop at the numerous roadside farms stands for fresh produce, baked goods and flowers.
If you want to avoid crowds, discover hidden beaches, cycle on country roads and sample the slower pace of life that Salt Spring has to offer, the south is where it's at.
host_about:
A warm welcome to our Airb&b community and guests.  Thank you for your interest in our guest house here on beautiful Salt Spring Island.

Tiny Haven was home to our young family for nearly four years, a space we constructed ourselves in order to live simply, consciously and in harmony with nature and the seasons.  For over twenty years we were tourists on Salt Spring, camping, hiking and exploring the island's lakes, farms, eateries and hidden beaches.  We always dreamed of making this island our home and in 2018 we rolled our tiny house onto the Fulford ferry and settled it into its forever home.  We feel incredibly privileged to be raising our two children in a rural community that values deep nature connection, slow food, creativity and play.

Jocelyn is a Registered Nurse whose nursing career is currently on hiatus while she works to transform our small (0.8 acre) piece of land into a thriving micro-homestead.  Building deep, home-based seasonal rhythms into her family's life and tending the hearth of the home is a great source of joy and contentment for her.  She is passionate about hiking, cycling with her children on her family cargo bike, food gardening, cooking from scratch and camping in our province's incredible parks.   She loves equally Salt Spring's vibrant, buzzing summers and slow, drizzly winters. 

Jarvis is a home-based software developer who can't resist a DIY project.  From carpentry to gardening to mechanical pursuits, he enjoys getting his hands dirty and learning new skills.   He is an avid cyclist who loves road tripping, camping, homemade apple pie and a fully stocked wood shed.

As a family of four we delight in the simple pleasures of island life; taking night walks on our quiet road and marvelling at how bright the stars shine, sharing picnic dinners on the beach, and gorging ourselves on blackberries in the summer.  We strive to live lightly and reduce our carbon footprint by eating local, buying secondhand, cycling, avoiding plastics, and finding recreation and rejuvenation in our own beautiful backyard.  

We hope you'll come share our little slice of paradise in Salt Spring's stunning south end.

description:

Enjoy the privacy and serenity of the Forest Retreat guest suite perched on the edge of Thetis Lake Park on southern Vancouver Island. Just a 20 minute drive to Victoria and a 5 minute walk to the lakeshore, this is a tranquil home base close to all amenities. A perfect place for a couples escape, outdoor enthusiasts, or a small family getaway. The suite is best suited for one couple or a small family with up to 2 children.
neighborhood_overview:
Located in the desirable Thetis Heights neighbourhood of Langford, we are steps from the bus stop yet tucked away in a quiet cul-de-sac on a private and tranquil property on the edge of the forest. We are just a 30 second walk to the scenic hiking trails of Thetis Lake Regional Park and 5 minutes from the lakeshore where you can enjoy pristine swimming, fishing, and light water sports.

It's the perfect location for the golf or outdoor enthusiast being 10 minutes from Bear Mountain Golf resort and spa, and a short drive to amazing, beaches, hiking, parks and all the south Island has to offer. We are conveniently a 2 minute drive to grocery stores, shopping, pubs and restaurants.

Langford is central to any area of Victoria you may want to explore. Downtown Victoria's many attractions or Butchart Gardens and Sidney are only 30 minutes away. Or head towards Sooke and go ziplining at Adrena Line or check out some beautiful beaches and views at China or Botanical Beach
host_about: Born and raised on the West Coast and Saltspring Island , I feel very blessed to live in this beautiful part of the world. Gordon Head has 27 parks ranging in size from the minuscule Balmacarra Park (671 m2 (0.166 acres)) to the magnificent Mount Douglas Park (181 ha (450 acres)), the largest park in Saanich.

Several parks offer beach access. The half-rocky, half-sandy beach located between Arbutus Cove Park and Hollydene Park is Gordon Head's most frequented beach.

Located in a the Wild Coast Cottage community. There are neighbours close by. Privacy may be limited in outdoor areas.

If you don’t feel like cooking The Renfrew Pub, Bridgeman’s West Coast Eatery down at the marina, Coastal Kitchen Café and Tomi’s Home Cooking are all a short walk away. The local General Store is about a 1km walk along Parkinson Rd and has a small selection of groceries, beer & wine. It’s a good idea to stock up on groceries on your way to Port Renfrew either in Sooke on your way from Victoria or in Lake Cowichan.

The list of activities in Port Renfrew are endless; seeing some of Canada’s tallest trees, getting close and personal with marine life at Botanical Beach and hiking the West Coast and Juan De Fuca trails. There is also surfing, kayaking, beach combing, whale watching, storm watching and world class fishing.
host_about:
Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.

host_about:
Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.

host_about:
Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.

host_about:
Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.

host_about:
My husband Howie and I will be your hosts. My mother, Jan and step father, Maurie Turner completed building their home in 1978. This was intended to be and became their dream home. 

They have always wanted to create a bed and breakfast but never got around to it. My mother, unfortunately passed away in 2014. We are now full-filling her wish to open her home to guests from around the world to share and enjoy the beauty of Vancouver Island that we have had the privilege to call home for over 50 years.  

We are in a two phase process. We are opening the first suite in our house at the moment and will have an 1100 sq ft. guest home on the property available by spring. We are continuing my mother's love of flower gardens to create an inviting yard to sit and relax on a warm summer evening or pull a ripe apple or plum from my mother's fruit trees. 

I owned and rented a guest cottage in California back in the '80's and had so much fun and many wonderful memories with our clients. We look forward to meeting you and creating new ones!

I love the outdoors, hiking, and backpacking, mostly solo, sometimes with friends or hiking groups. I really like ballet, dancing and watching live performances. I wish I could be really good at it, but I started as an adult, so I need to be patient with myself. :)

I love my family even though they're quite quirky. I like hanging out and laughing with friends, especially when we go on long hikes together or eat together. I really like foods, especially natural, healthy ingredients. I also like the chewy texture and starchy foods. :)

I love to travel, meet other solo travelers, and make new friends, then invite them to my hometown in Vietnam or in Canada.

If I can get around to it, I'd like to take acrylic painting lessons, swimming lessons, guitar and piano lessons, photography, and pottery lessons. I recently tried bouldering and now I have another activity added to my list. :)

You’ll appreciate the community vibe (quiet), the ambiance (friendly), and easy access to everything Victoria.

Walk / cycle the Galloping Goose-Lochside Trail from right outside your door! This well loved trail winds its way all over the city and beyond; explore or paddle Cordova Bay beach; dine at The Beach House Restaurant… or hike the numerous parks and walking trails nearby. Take a short drive and you can swim, hike or canoe at the popular Elk / Beaver Lake Regional Park, enjoy 3 golf courses, and take advantage of our community centre: Saanich Commonwealth Place (library, gym, pool).

neighborhood_overview:
Located in a the Wild Coast Cottage community. There are neighbours close by. Privacy may be limited in outdoor areas.

Please note that each cottage in the neighbourhood is privately owned. If you visit at another cottage and bring dishes, chairs etc. please be sure to return them to their original cottage. Some cottages are rented like ours, but most are used only by their owners and families. Please be respectful of their privacy and property.
host_about:
Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.

name: Bright Character Home
description: Our home is a fully-furnished, very bright character house from 1912, with original fir flooring, stained glass, and 10-foot ceilings on the main floor.  We’re in James Bay, which is Victoria’s oldest residential neighbourhood. Downtown, cafes, grocery stores and the beach are all within a short walking distance. Kid-friendly set-up.
neighborhood_overview:
We’re in James Bay, which is Victoria’s oldest residential neighbourhood (actually the oldest on the west coast north of San Francisco). This means that there are lots of stately Victorian and Edwardian houses, as well as horse-drawn carriages which bring tourists down our street each day to look at them.

Our house is an excellent base for exploring both the urban and natural highlights of Victoria. We’re less than a 10-minute walk to the Inner Harbour (you can see the statue on top of the Parliament Buildings from the master bedroom window), and a couple minutes more to the rest of downtown.

A couple minutes’ walk in the other direction takes you to the staggeringly beautiful cliffs overlooking the beach on Dallas Road, and also to Beacon Hill Park (Victoria’s original and best city park).

host_about:
Hello Airbnb community!

We've been married and living in bliss in Tofino on Vancouver Island since 2013!  :) We have been coming to Tofino since the 1990s as its such a special place! We are both passionate about health, food, adventure, the environment, surfing, biking, travel and meeting other people! 

Michelle is a Wellness Host & Environmental Consultant. She is schooled in Environmental practice, as well as massage, yoga and nutrition! She also works for a local community foundation who hold the UNESCO designation for Clayoquot Sound Biosphere Region and is a well-loved community builder and storyteller. Don't be surprised if you find yourself signing up to do something amazing!  Alan is your main host for Cedarwood Cove, alongside Koli the rescue pup! They will make sure you have everything you need to make your time with us the best. Alan loves everything to do with getting outside, especially mountain biking, any biking! and surf. He's your number one goto for weather updates, bike fixes, where to get coffee, and surf reports. He has an extreme soft spot for dogs and his kindness to people is heartwarming, don't be afraid to hug him. 

The best experience to have with us at Cedarwood Cove is stand up paddleboarding!! It is hands down the most unique experience you could try!! We are both qualified instructors,  so please take a tour with us, we will have you paddling like a pro in no time and you will love the rugged coastline.

Together we make great hosts, who love to inspire you to get outside and have fun. We love to laugh and be silly, to share wine and chocolate and listen to your story. We also value your privacy and we too value our solitude.

As guests we love to travel via Airbnb as it gives us the best insights on local knowledge. Travelling via Airbnb always feels so homely and comfortable. We like to surf if possible in every place we visit, Costa Rica and Mexico being big favourites. But farm hopping across New Zealand and dancing our way through European festivals, riding Indonesian waves and eating Cornish pasties have left great memories for us as well. 

We try to minimise our carbon footprint in many ways and do our best to reduce our consumption as well as avoiding as much plastic as possible and aiming for zero waste.

Michelle can't live without fresh juice, coconut oil, the ocean, Koli and books.  Alan can't live without his bike, potatoes, surfing, tooth floss and Michelle :)

host_about:
Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.

host_about:
Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.

host_about:
Ken and Joy embarked on the journey of purchasing Handsome Dan’s from Handsome Dan and The French Girl in the summer of 2020 amongst all the chaos of covid-19. 

They were looking for a business they could call their own and benefit from all their hard work and ideas instead of seeing CEO’s and upper office management always reaping the rewards, while telling other managers and workers they needed to cut back, or there were no bonuses for the year. 

The journey here was not easy - they spent 6 months apart while trying to sell their house in Saskatchewan, and then in late April 2021 they got some wonderful news - their current tenant insurer in BC said they would cover a landlord policy for a house in SK. 

In May 2021 Ken gave away or had to throw away 98% of the household items they had collected over the years - since they were moving from a huge house in SK just over 3000 sq ft with an extra wide 2 car garage into a less than 650 sq. Ft basement suite in BC. 

The transition of purchasing Handsome Dan’s and moving halfway across the country during a pandemic none the less wasn’t the easiest but they got through and now they are excited to expand and build Handsome Dan’s vacation rental property management in Port Renfrew and across the island to help cottage owners see a return on their investment, and for guests to have an amazing experience from the time they book their vacation till the time they leave; and even after raving about the experience they had at a Handsome Dan property. 

Port Renfrew is a favourite destination for a day or overnight trip on Vancouver Island. Each visit, no matter what time of year you are consumed by the natural majesty of this little community and the breath taking earthly beauty that surrounds it. 

We invite you to stay in our cottages and enjoy a few days, or weeks any time of the year. There is much to do and see. Or simply do nothing for extended periods of time, but sit quietly and listen to the ocean.  All of the cottages are privately owned and decorated to the taste of the owners.  We invite you to check them  out and are excited to share this special place with you.
